# Language logo artwork

These official assets are used to identify the documentation language. Their
inclusion does not imply endorsement by either language project.

## Ruby — `ruby.svg`

- Source: [Ruby's official website](https://www.ruby-lang.org/images/header-ruby-logo.svg).
- Copyright © 2006, Yukihiro Matsumoto.
- License: [Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 2.5](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/2.5/), as stated on [Ruby's logo page](https://www.ruby-lang.org/en/about/logo/).
- Changes: none; displayed at the selector's icon size.

## Rust — `rust.svg`

- Source: [Rust's official white-outline logo](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust-artwork/blob/7b54b6689dc310db2f301d7bcda847f016bd447c/logo/rust-logo-white-outline.svg).
- Copyright: Rust Foundation.
- License: [Creative Commons Attribution 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/), as stated in the [artwork license](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust-artwork/blob/7b54b6689dc310db2f301d7bcda847f016bd447c/logo/README.md).
- Changes: none; renamed locally and displayed at the selector's icon size. The supplied white outline keeps the logo visible on both light and dark backgrounds.
